title: 電動車功率逆變器
summary: 以電力電子角色在示意波形與合成數據間比對損耗、死區與熱路，不輸出真機驅動訊號。
summaryEn: Compare loss, dead time and thermal paths using schematic waveforms and synthetic data without driving real power hardware.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創汽車與交通工具教學。所有數值均為明示假設，不是同名車輛的實測規格、認證或維修設定。使用試算表、紙面圖、合成資料及自行準備的離線模型；不提供真實高壓、道路、壓力設備或控制器操作授權。
scopeEn: Original automotive teaching based on public principles. All numerical inputs are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vehicle specifications, certification criteria or maintenance settings. Use worksheets, paper diagrams, synthetic data and offline models you prepare; no authorization for real high-voltage, road, pressure-equipment or controller operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察

stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 充電功率與電流：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Charging power and current: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 充電功率與電流 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Charging power and current and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 本課觀察對象為功率模組、閘極訊號與冷板界面。DC功率由端電壓與電流決定；車輛、接頭與供電端限制取最嚴者。
steps.instructionEn: This course follows power modules, gate signals and cold-plate interfaces. DC power is voltage times current; vehicle, connector and supply limits all constrain operation.
steps.observation: 獨立教學工況，非原廠或實測規格；跨單元整合須先統一輸入及分配邊界：P=VI；V=400 V、I=150 A；計算結果=60 kW。
steps.observationEn: Independent teaching operating point, not OEM or measured specifications; reconcile inputs and allocation boundaries before cross-unit integration: P=VI; V=400 V, I=150 A; result=60 kW.
steps.failure: 電流下降可能為電池接受能力、接頭溫度或站端分配；檢查每端狀態。

steps.checkEn: DC power is 60 kW; station peak rating is not session-average power. Relate this interpretation to power modules, gate signals and cold-plate interfaces and record measurement locations, boundaries and data version.
